text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx gateway errors for /v1/generate (gateway=edge-proxy-2). P95 latency also up. Paging #eng-oncall.

samir: saw it, digging. beginning runbook checklist. can someone grab customer impact?

taylor: I’m on customer pages — support dashboards show ~12% of requests 5xx for a handful of routes, mostly from eu-west1. Customers reporting slow responses.

ops-runner: quick ask — can we mute the noisy alert group while we mitigate? don’t want paging flood.

maria: agree. propose a 15m silence on alertmanager for the "gateway_5xx_high" rule, then we adjust thresholds and add a route filter. will open a PR for the rule change.

samir: small mitigation: flip fallback routing to model-variant-b for traffic to reduce backend errors. running step now.

jia: adding a short-term dashboard tile to monitor 5xx by upstream and by route. will post link when ready. also creating an alerting filter for upstream="thirdparty-ml-host" so we can separate provider failures from our runtime.

maria: suggested rule patch (draft):
```yaml
- alert: Gateway5xxHigh
  expr: sum by (route)(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum by(route)(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[1m])) > 0.10
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: critical
```
change is raising the ratio threshold to 10% and add for:2m to reduce noisy bursts.

samir: thanks. also adding label upstream=~"thirdparty-.*" into alerts to avoid paging when it's a third-party outage.

ops-runner: I silenced alertmanager group "gateway-alerts" for 20m. will lift if we need follow-up.

taylor: customer-impact note: top three customers affected — billing jobs delayed, some webhook failures. logging support incidents.

jia: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/5xx-overview?orgId=1 (tile: 5xx by route & upstream). added annotation for mitigation start at 2493001260.

maria: created PR infra/alerting#432 with the proposed change + tests. requesting review from eng-sre.

samir: fallback routing reduced errors by ~60% in metric view. still seeing upstream error spikes from thirdparty-ml-host.

ops-runner: recommend next steps for postmortem: 1) permanent alert split by upstream, 2) tuning thresholds per route (some have naturally higher failure rates), 3) runbook update to include temporary silence step, 4) add synthetic health check that isolates third-party latency.

taylor: I'll file the incident ticket with customer impact summary and link to PR + dashboard.

maria: follow-up tasks assigned in the incident doc. will schedule a 30m review with eng-sre and runtime tomorrow.

samir: handing off to night oncall in 20m — @taylor please escalate if errors creep above 8% again. leaving notes in runbook.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident marked 'mitigated' by samir at 2493001745. Silence will expire at 2493002045.

jia: post-incident ops checklist: add a per-route baseline with adaptive thresholds (rolling 6h p95), and create a dashboard alert that triggers only when both ratio and absolute count cross thresholds to avoid noisy alerts from very low-volume routes.

maria: agreed. I’ll include suggested baselines in the PR description.

samir: thanks everyone — closing thread for now. feel free to @eng-oncall if anything re-surges.
